headline.text: L3 ML4 metal detector belt on TG5 *damaged and ripping* — line down at 07:02 pending maintenance inspection to assess contamination risk.

summary: Two L3 ML4 issues today: metal detector belt damage halted TG5, and dirty molds staged Friday caused candy exposure on approximately 1 in 3 bars until operator removal began. L2 ML2 shadow board missing wrench #13.

food_safety.title: Metal detector belt damaged and ripping on TG5
food_safety.summary: Belt on ML4 TG5 metal detector is damaged and tearing; line stopped immediately to prevent belt material from entering product stream pending maintenance inspection.
food_safety.status: Open — line down pending maintenance inspection.

quality.title: Candy exposure on ~33% of ML4 bars due to dirty molds
quality.summary: Approximately one bar per three molds showing candy exposure; root cause is dirty molds left in system Friday and staged in preheat cabinet before vision system activated Monday morning.
quality.status: Open at window close — operator removing affected bars; clean molds being swapped, ~60 min cycle remaining.

sanitation.title: Wrench #13 missing from ML2 shadow board
sanitation.summary: First shift centerline check identified wrench #13 missing from ML2 flow wrap shadow board; tool control gap.
sanitation.status: Open — wrench #13 unaccounted for as of first shift.

opportunities.text: Consider implementing shift-end shadow board sign-off with photo documentation — based on today's missing wrench #13 discovery at ML2 first shift startup.
Consider adding visual mold cleanliness verification before staging in preheat cabinet — based on today's ML4 dirty molds that bypassed vision system checks and caused candy exposure on ~33% of bars.
Consider adding belt condition inspection to metal detector preventive maintenance checklist — based on today's TG5 damaged/ripping belt that halted production for food safety review.
